description: Send this workspace's catalog, or just the products you name, to Google Merchant Center now — the same as the "Update now" button on the Google Merchant channel page. It is a REAL write to Google: products become or stay visible in Google Shopping. It runs only the product push the owner has ALREADY armed on the connection (otherwise it is refused) and only after the owner accepted Google's terms; it never arms anything and never changes settings. Refused until the owner switches on AI publishing. It is rarely needed: an hourly job sends the catalog anyway, so use it only when a fix must reach Google before the next run. To get one fixed product to Google immediately pass productIds (1 to 25): only those products are sent, and the result is { adapterId, adapterName, sent, failed, blocked, notOnChannel } — sent and failed (with Google's own message) name each product, blocked carries the readiness reason, notOnChannel lists ids that are not active channel members; this does not change the channel's last-run summary. Without productIds the whole catalog is sent, never-sent and changed products first, bounded by a time budget — if truncated is true, call it again. Returns { adapterId, adapterName, outcome } where outcome has pushed, failed, blocked, ready, total, truncated, lastSyncAt and failedSample (up to 5 refused products with Google's message). A failure that came back from Google carries reason (for example auth_expired) with details.needsReconnect and details.whatToDo: auth_expired, such as invalid_grant, means a person must reconnect the Google account on the adapter page, and retrying will not help. Use check_channel_readiness first to see which products would be withheld, and get_marketplace for the last run. Not idempotent. The result echoes the workspace.

adapterId.description: The Google Merchant connection to push (adapter id, listed by get_marketplace for google_merchant). Omit it when the workspace has exactly one Google Merchant connection — the server picks it; with several connections the call is refused until one is named.

productIds.description: Product ids (1 to 25) to send to Google right now instead of the whole catalog. Use it to get a fixed product to Google at once. Each id must be an active member of the Google channel; others come back as notOnChannel, products the readiness rule withholds as blocked (with the reason), and Google's refusals as failed (with Google's own message). Omit it to push the whole catalog in priority order.

name: push_google_merchant_catalog
title: Push catalog to Google Merchant
